Localization.Description: Local Bambu Lab monitoring, AMS, camera and finished-part reminders for Ulanzi D200X.
Localization.Overview: A local-first Bambu Lab dashboard on your Ulanzi D200X.
Localization.Detail: Community plugin. Discover and pair a local printer using its LAN Access Code. View progress, ETA, layers, temperatures, AMS and camera. Local bed reminders are advisory. Only chamber-light control is included. See the GitHub compatibility table before installing.
